risk_note: RV2 by path (catalog admin pool; no money, ledger, settlement or attribution change). FU-POOL-CATEGORY-BLOCK (orchestrator D10-1045 ② / D10-1058 / D10-1059; contract CT-26zf #2954 merged, error code 30147 category_blocked, admin only). The admin pool add (POST /admin/v1/product-pools/{pool_id}/items) and the offline→online re-check of PATCH refuse a live union detail (incl. price_status=anomaly) whose category hits an active blocklist rule of the same app and platform with 422 / 30147 and write nothing (no insert, no overwrite, no takedown of same-key rows, no product_refs row on the re-check path). The category is judged in pool-source.ts only when the admin wiring passes the new category option, after multi-link dedup / exactly-one-item / 50401, and on re-parse before takeRawItemId registers product_refs; order follows the CT-26zf openapi text (param / permission refusals first, category before price). Non-live answers keep the existing 30141 / 50401 / offline behaviour. A live detail without category matches keyword rules against the title only; warns catalog_category_missing / catalog_category_blocked with prefix pool_admin:, platform and count only. Pool candidates (searchPoolCandidates) filter blocked categories like the search tab. Rules are read per call (no cache). Container green check OOM-killed twice on Colima 8G; per D10-772 the host-int run (host test runner, PG on colima) passed pool-category-block + product-pool-admin + category-blocklist-search: 14 files, 198 tests. Full verification by the required CI checks.

reviews.note: Codex money review (effort medium). Round 1 fail with two S1 (judge the category only after multi-link dedup, so a multi-item link keeps its earlier refusal; on re-parse judge before takeRawItemId registers product_refs), both fixed in 9ff3b1792 (duplicate key derivation removed). Round 2 (incremental) pass, no findings, previous two S1 confirmed closed. Before that, five round-2 calls (Codex ×3 incremental, fresh independent Claude ×2) returned pass with no findings but were rejected by validate-output for checklist lines outside the diff hunks (no usable output, not counted as rounds); per D10-1121 the task brief got a section listing the citable hunk lines, and the next Codex call produced this usable pass. The money canary ran (record only, CT-06zzzza).
